newsitem.title: FINLAND: RESEARCH ALERT - NATWEST KEEPS FINNAIR BUY.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - NATWEST KEEPS FINNAIR BUY.

text.p: NatWest Securities reiterated its buy recommendation on Finnish national carrier Finnair Oy in a European Daily Notes research report on Monday.

"With one month's traffic figures remaining in fiscal 1997, Finnair's volumes have increased slightly more than our forecast," NatWest said, putting the rise in the airline's volumes at 4.7 percent against a forecast of three percent.
Finnair's financial yeare runs to end-March. On April 4, Finnair reported passenger traffic up 2.6 percent year-on-year in February and cargo traffic was up 13.6 percent.
"The outlook for the Finnish economy is encouraging and Finnair's performance improvement plan, which includes selling off the hotels business, should begin to bear fruit this year," NatWest said.

Finnair, Norwegian Braathens and Transswede of Sweden, which last week announced plans to combine their frequent flyer programmes, "are gradually evolving into a single second force capable of competing with SAS," NatWest said.
